title.narrative: Supporting the Turkish Ministry of Health with medical items

description.narrative: Filling the major shortage of medicines, solutions and infant formula in hospitals and health centers in the Republic of Turkey and helping to alleviate the suffering of our affected Turkish brothers and residents.
Providing assistance in the health sector with medicines, solutions, and infant formula, which helps alleviate the deficit in hospitals and health centers in the Republic of Turkey.

Providing medical relief aid to support the Turkish Ministry of Health. Providing a helping hand to those affected by the earthquake regarding the health aspect. Supporting the Turkish Ministry of Health with medicines, solutions and infant formula
